policy.note: A compact-source transfer never clears the bandpass blocker on its own. The pilots already passed point-source colour calibration and still failed the resolved-galaxy transfer by 5 to 13 times the tolerance. This stage measures whether a Rubin colour term exists and how much residual it removes; the extended-source test is separate.

regions.interpretation: This is a compact-source result. Point sources are unresolved and share the PSF, so a colour term fitted here does not establish that the same transfer holds across a resolved galaxy, where the stellar population, dust, and surface brightness all vary with radius. The extended-source transfer remains the open blocker.
